name: icor-for-life-planner
description: Headless gates for the ICOR for Life - Planner plugin. main.js has no build step; this exists only so `npm test` has somewhere to live.

scripts.pretest: node -e "const fs=require('fs');let f=[];try{f=fs.readdirSync('test').filter(n=>n.endsWith('.test.cjs'))}catch(e){};if(f.length<6){console.error('SUITE INCOMPLETE: found '+f.length+' test files, expected at least 6. An empty run is not a pass.');process.exit(1)}"
